seo.title: Apia homeless help - No Home Help
seo.description: Verified shelter, food, health, safety, legal and social support for people experiencing homelessness in Apia.

page.heading: APIA - HOMELESS HELP
page.urgent: Immediate danger: Police 995. Medical emergency: ambulance 996. Violence or emergency shelter: Samoa Victim Support Group 27904 or 25392.
page.notice: Information and availability can change. Call before travelling when possible. A listing does not guarantee a bed, meal, appointment, benefit, treatment or job.
page.intro: Samoa Victim Support Group is the main published referral for crisis shelter in Apia. For other housing or welfare needs, contact the Ministry of Women, Community and Social Development; accommodation is not guaranteed and may depend on assessment and family circumstances.
page.footer: Main sources: Samoa Ministry of Health, Ministry of Women Community and Social Development, Samoa Victim Support Group, Samoa Family Health Association, Samoa Red Cross and Ministry of Commerce Industry and Labour.

entries.title: Samoa Victim Support Group
entries.description: Crisis support, shelter or housing referral, financial assistance and case management for survivors of violence and vulnerable families.
entries.how_to_access: Call 27904 or 25392. If there is immediate danger call Police 995.

entries.title: Ministry of Women, Community and Social Development
entries.description: Government social-welfare case management and referral for families and people in crisis.
entries.address: Tooa Salamasina Community Center, Sogi, Apia
entries.how_to_access: Call or visit and ask for the Social Development or welfare team.

entries.title: Samoa Victim Support Group shelter referral
entries.description: The Ministry of Health referral directory identifies Samoa Victim Support Group for shelter and housing in cases involving violence or abuse. Placement is confidential and depends on assessment.
entries.how_to_access: Call SVSG. Do not travel to a confidential shelter without referral.

entries.title: Samoa Red Cross Society
entries.description: Humanitarian, health and disaster assistance through the national society and volunteer network. It is not a guaranteed daily shelter or food service.
entries.how_to_access: Call and explain the need. Use emergency services for immediate danger.

entries.title: Tupua Tamasese Meaole Hospital
entries.description: Main referral hospital serving Apia and Upolu. Use emergency services for urgent medical conditions.
entries.how_to_access: Attend the emergency department for urgent care or call ambulance 996.

entries.title: Samoa Family Health Association
entries.description: Sexual and reproductive health care, counselling and support groups. The national gender-based-violence referral protocol lists the Apia service.
entries.how_to_access: Call for an appointment or current walk-in information.

entries.title: Government social welfare
entries.description: Social-welfare case management and referrals through the Ministry of Women, Community and Social Development.
entries.address: Tooa Salamasina Community Center, Sogi, Apia
entries.how_to_access: Ask for an assessment and bring any identification or family information available.

entries.title: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour - Employment Services
entries.description: Government labour-market services, apprenticeships, worker-rights information and links to the MCIL jobs portal.
entries.how_to_access: Visit or call the Employment Services team and ask how to register or view vacancies.

entries.title: Labour Employment Export Programme
entries.description: Government labour-mobility programme. Registration and selection rules apply; it does not guarantee a job.
entries.address: Level 2, Samoa National Provident Fund Building, Apia
entries.how_to_access: Contact the LEEP office and ask about current registration requirements.

entries.title: Ministry of Justice legal aid
entries.description: The national health referral protocol directs people seeking legal aid in Apia to the Ministry of Justice, Courts and Administration.
entries.how_to_access: Call 22671, 22672 or 22673 and ask for legal-aid intake.

entries.title: Samoa Victim Support Group crisis support
entries.description: Confidential crisis support, counselling, shelter referral and advocacy for survivors of domestic or sexual violence and child abuse.
entries.how_to_access: Call 27904 or 25392. Police Domestic Violence Unit can be reached through Police 995 in an emergency.
